newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains quiet and mixed - Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains quiet and mixed - Jan 31.

text.p: Trading remained quiet on the UK cash grain market on Friday with mixed values.
Delivered market traded levels ranged from two stg up to 1.50 stg down but brokers said trade was thin.
"Farmers are not selling and even if they were there isn't any demand," said one broker.

The story was much the same on the export market with brokers reporting only a couple of trades when feed wheat fetched 97.25 stg for Mar and 99.25 stg for May fob east coast ports in 2,400 tonnes loads.
Delivered market milling wheat 11 percent protein traded at 112 stg for Feb and 112.75 stg or Mar in the London area while in Liverpool 116.50 stg was paid for Feb.
Feed wheat in Liverpool traded at 97.50 stg for Feb and 98.50 stg for Mar.
In the Avon range 95, 95.50 and 96 stg was paid for feed wheat while on Humberside it traded at 97 stg.
Apr/Jun fetched 99.50 stg in East Anglia.
Feed barley was trading between 95.50 to 99.50 stg a tonne for Feb depending on area.
